supper_01.speaker: Narrator
supper_01.text: Hold Greyfen. Midwinter. The great hall smells of salt-broth and wet wool. Torches spit against the fog that crawls in under the doors.

supper_02.speaker: Kael
supper_02.text: I stand where a sworn messenger stands: near the door, satchel on my hip, listening for a name that needs a letter more than a blade.

supper_03.speaker: Lord Greyfen
supper_03.text: …and if the inland crowns want our road, they can buy the salt like honest thieves.

supper_04.speaker: Narrator
supper_04.text: Laughter. Then Lord Greyfen’s cup hits the table wrong. His hand finds his throat. The hall goes quiet in pieces.

supper_05.speaker: Steward Maelis
supper_05.text: Poison. Not fever. Seal the gates. No one leaves. Get the heir to the solar—now.

supper_06.speaker: Captain Veyra
supper_06.text: Seal us in with whoever poured that cup? I want riders on the cliff road before the fog thickens.

supper_07.speaker: Narrator
supper_07.text: Lord Greyfen does not rise. Someone screams for a healer who will not matter. The steward’s eyes find mine.

corridor_01.speaker: Narrator
corridor_01.text: Torchlight in the corridor. Cold stone. The heir—Lira Greyfen—is pale but upright. The steward and captain argue over her head like weather.

corridor_02.speaker: Steward Maelis
corridor_02.text: Messenger. You heard the order. The heir stays locked until dawn. You run my seals—nothing else.

corridor_03.speaker: Captain Veyra
corridor_03.text: Or you open a gate and we find who paid for this night. Standing still is how holds die.

corridor_04.speaker: Lira
corridor_04.text: Kael. Father trusted you with things he wouldn’t put in a steward’s ledger. Don’t let them talk as if I’m already a seal on a door.

corridor_choice.speaker: Kael
corridor_choice.text: The hall is still shouting. My satchel feels heavier than it should.

choices.text: "I'll stay with Lira until the solar's secured."
"I'll follow the steward's seals. For now."
"First I check what I was carrying tonight."

letter_01.speaker: Narrator
letter_01.text: In the quiet outside the solar, I open my satchel for a wax-check. A letter I did not receive sits under the courier strips—Greyfen seal, but the wax is wrong.

letter_02.speaker: Narrator
letter_02.text: It is warm. Not from my body. The seal looks like ash that forgot how to cool. When my thumb brushes it, the corridor torch dips—just once—as if something else inhaled.

letter_03.speaker: Kael
letter_03.text: This was never meant for a messenger’s bag. It was planted. Or it wanted to be found.

letter_04.speaker: Steward Maelis
letter_04.text: Kael. Whatever you’ve found goes to me. Succession is a knife. Don’t hand it to a grieving child.

letter_05.speaker: Lira
letter_05.text: If it’s Father’s seal, it’s mine to open. If it isn’t—then someone already decided I shouldn’t live to ask.

major_choice.speaker: Narrator
major_choice.text: Midnight presses against the shutters. Protect the heir—or obey the steward. There is no clean third road that keeps both.

choices.text: Give the letter to Lira. Guard her door.
Deliver the letter to Steward Maelis. Lock the solar.

heir_01.speaker: Narrator
heir_01.text: Lira breaks the warm seal. For a breath the solar smells like a forge that never was. Her face hardens.

heir_02.speaker: Lira
heir_02.text: It’s a claim of wardship. Maelis would hold Greyfen “until I am fit.” Signed in a hand that isn’t Father’s—close enough to fool a hall.

heir_03.speaker: Kael
heir_03.text: Then the steward doesn’t get this night. I bar the solar. Captain Veyra can keep the corridor mean.

heir_04.speaker: Captain Veyra
heir_04.text: Good. I’ll put three trusted on the stair. If Maelis wants the heir, he can explain it with witnesses.

heir_05.speaker: Narrator
heir_05.text: Dawn is still hours away. Outside the shutters, fog coils like it is listening. You chose the heir. The steward will not forget.

steward_01.speaker: Narrator
steward_01.text: Maelis takes the letter without thanks. The warm seal does not surprise him. That is worse than surprise.

steward_02.speaker: Steward Maelis
steward_02.text: Wise. Lock the solar. Tell Lira the healer needs quiet. Tell the captain the gates stay shut—on my authority as acting hand.

steward_03.speaker: Lira
steward_03.text: Kael—? You’re locking me in. Father said you ran truth, not cages.

steward_04.speaker: Kael
steward_04.text: I’m keeping you alive until morning. That’s the oath I can still keep.

steward_05.speaker: Narrator
steward_05.text: The bar drops. Somewhere in the keep, a seal is pressed into soft wax that should have cooled. You obeyed the steward. The heir will remember the sound of the lock.

protect_heir.title: The Heir’s Watch
protect_heir.body: You gave Lira the planted letter and stood her door. Steward Maelis lost the night—and gained a reason. Hold Greyfen wakes to a contested succession and a messenger who chose blood over seals.
protect_heir.tease: Next: the inland crowns smell weakness. Something in the wax still won’t cool.

obey_steward.title: The Steward’s Seal
obey_steward.body: You delivered the letter and locked the solar. Maelis holds the claim; Lira holds the wound. Hold Greyfen is quiet until dawn—and quieter is not safer.
obey_steward.tease: Next: a sealed wardship travels faster than grief. The warm wax has more names.

none.title: Unfinished Road
none.body: The night did not resolve. Reload and choose.
